section_header: BODY ELECTRICAL SYSTEM — Theft Deterrent System
title: Theft Deterrent System

content.text: Diode (For RH Key Unlock Switch and Horn)

content.description: Three-terminal diode connector showing terminals numbered 1, 2, and 3 in a rectangular housing

items: (a) Connect the test leads of the ohmmeter to terminals 1 and 2, and check for continuity. Next, reverse the test leads and check, again, for continuity.
(b) Connect the test leads of the ohmmeter to terminals 2 and 3, and check for continuity. Next, reverse the test leads and check, again, for continuity.

content.text: If both of the test results are same condition, replace the diode.
If both of the test results are same condition, replace the diode.

content.description: Horn with two wire connections shown, connected to a rectangular battery or power source

content.text: Connect the positive (+) lead from the battery to terminal 1. Connect the negative (−) lead to terminal 2.
If operation is not as specified, replace the horn.
